title: Settling an Auto Loan in Full and Closing It
content:
Where a borrower settles a loan of the Auto Loans line in full, the settlement posts to the loan, the unpaid principal and the unpaid charges fall to nothing, the loan is closed as paid off and the lien on the vehicle moves to awaiting release.

**The amount required to settle the loan in full is fixed only after the refund owed on the waiver coverage financed with the loan stands entered on its records.** Where the loan's records carry no such refund entry, or still show that coverage as in force, the amount required to settle the loan is not yet fixed.

## The capability

The servicing desk's tool `post_loan_payoff_a84c6454` posts a borrower's settlement of an auto loan in full to that loan and closes it. The payment posts to the loan's activity today with the split passed in between unpaid charges, accrued interest and principal, and it settles the loan: unpaid principal and unpaid charges both fall to zero, the loan is shown as paid off with today as its closing date, the past-due day count returns to zero, and the lien on the vehicle is moved to awaiting release so the title work can start. The borrower sees the payment and the closed loan straight away with the payment's own reference number.

## How it is invoked

The tool is hidden. The agent unlocks `post_loan_payoff_a84c6454` and then calls it; the agent posts the settlement themselves rather than handing it to the borrower.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_loan_id` | The reference number of the auto loan being settled, read from the loan record returned by the auto loan lookup before the call | Id |
| `customer_id` | The reference number identifying the borrower on that loan, read from the customer profile lookup before the call | Id |
| `settlement_amount` | The total the borrower is paying to settle the loan | USD with 2 decimal places, positive, and exactly the sum of the parts named below |
| `fees_portion` | The part of the settlement that goes to the unpaid charges standing on the loan | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 where no charge stands |
| `interest_portion` | The part of the settlement that goes to the interest accrued on the loan | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 where no interest is owed |
| `principal_portion` | The part of the settlement that goes to the unpaid principal | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 where no principal remains |
| `payment_channel` | How the borrower is settling the loan | Enum |

The complete set of values `payment_channel` takes: `none`, where the entry is not a payment at all and so carries no channel; `autopay_pcb`, where the bank drafts the money automatically from the borrower's Piedmont Crescent checking account under a standing instruction; `pcb_transfer`, where the borrower moves the money themselves from a Piedmont Crescent account in online or branch banking; `external_ach`, where the money is drawn from an account held at another bank; `mail_check`, where a paper check is posted to the loan servicing address; `branch`, where the borrower pays in person at a branch counter; and `debit_card_phone`, where a debit card is given to the servicing agent on the telephone and the payment is taken on that card.

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the loan reference number, the payment reference number assigned to this settlement, the total paid in USD to the cent, the parts it was split into, the closing date recorded on the loan and the lien's new state. Receiving that sentence means the loan is settled and closed.
